text: Malaa'ikaajo on wi'i: "Fiyaake on kono mi wi'iri non, fii kala sonnaajo maa on jiidotaako, an kadi a hewtii hattirde ngurndan ɗan sabu nayewu ngun e lo'ere ƴi'e ɗen, kono Joomi maaɗa Daalii: Tgugol Joomi maaɗa Yahyaa immorde e neeniraawo dimaro e baabiraawo hewtuɗo hattirde ngurndan ɗan ko newiiɗum, gomɗii Mi Tagiino ma -an Jakariyaa- ko adii ɗum hari a laataaki huunde jaŋteteende, sabu hari an ko a waasaaɗo.
